QuestInfo.name: Deia's G-Potion
QuestInfo.0: Once a week, Deia provides a special potion to all users in a guild.
QuestInfo.1: Once a week, Deia provides a special potion to all users in a guild.

0.0: The Guild supplies have arrived. \nHere, take them. Goodness, complaints every time...\nDon't complain about the amount. If your Guild Level goes up, you will receive more.
